description: Configures logging once, at the app's startup - the only place that configures it (ARCH059 - no basicConfig, handler or root level anywhere else); every module takes its own logger with logging.getLogger(__name__). Level from the settings, one line per event with the request id, never a secret, a token or personal data; the tests put the logging back as it was after each test (a shared fixture of tests/conftest.py - later logs must not write to a test's closed stream).

decisions.question: Where do the logs go and in which format - e.g. stderr, one line per event with time, level, request id and message?
decisions.answer: stderr, one line per event: time, level, request id, message
decisions.suggested: stderr, one line per event: time, level, request id, message
